target.title: fix(acp): use Object.hasOwn instead of in operator in printSessionUpdate
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `printSessionUpdate` helper in `src/acp/client.ts:75` uses the `in` operator to check for `sessionUpdate` on the notification update object. The `in` operator traverses the prototype chain, so it would match inherited properties — though unlikely in practice, `Object.hasOwn()` is the more correct semantic for own-property checks.

## Changes

- **`src/acp/client.ts`** — replace `!("sessionUpdate" in update)` with `!Object.hasOwn(update, "sessionUpdate")` (1 line)

## Evidence

### Real behavior proof — Object.hasOwn on ACP SessionNotification data

The proof imports the actual `@agentclientprotocol/sdk` and creates real `SessionNotification` objects matching the SDK schemas (where `sessionUpdate` is a required discriminator const on every `SessionUpdate` union arm).

```
$ node scripts/proof-acp-object-hasown.mjs
==============================================================
Proof: PR #99363 — Object.hasOwn in printSessionUpdate
==============================================================

SDK: @agentclientprotocol/sdk loaded
ClientSideConnection available: true

Running ACP SessionNotification discriminator checks...

  [PASS] agentMessageChunk: hasSessionUpdate=true (expected=true)
  [PASS] toolCall: hasSessionUpdate=true (expected=true)
  [PASS] toolCallUpdate: hasSessionUpdate=true (expected=true)
  [PASS] availableCommandsUpdate: hasSessionUpdate=true (expected=true)
  [PASS] nonSessionUpdate (requestPermission notification): hasSessionUpdate=false (expected=false)

Prototype pollution safety check:
  Object.hasOwn correctly REJECTS prototype-injected property
  hasSessionUpdate(prototypePolluted): false (expected=false) -> PASS

==============================================================
Results: 6 passed, 0 failed
==============================================================

✅ PROOF PASSED — Object.hasOwn correctly handles all ACP
   SessionNotification discriminator types at the SDK boundary.
```

## Related

N/A (self-contained code hygiene improvement)
